The [[Aavman Extravagance]] '''Model 11-S Space Yacht''' was a large and luxurious [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]], favored by wealthy senior citizens.<ref name="PP" /> [[Leger DeMain]]'s [[Starship/Legends|starship]], ''[[Siren III]]'', was a heavily modified Model 11-S Space Yacht.<ref name="CRO" />
